ModMetaData.name: Wil's Role Modules : Treasury
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description:
WIL'S TREASURY (early development)
Money for a community: personal and household accounts, a community treasury, a physical Treasury Zone, quest rewards and trade proceeds shared by policy, trades paid from the treasury first and then from household accounts, wages and a payday on the 1st and 8th of every quadrum, the Treasurer, and (once a Tax Collector is appointed) taxation, collection visits and the disputes that follow.
Accounts are claims on the colony's real silver. Nothing here creates silver.
Requires Wil's Community Framework. It does not need Wil's Role Modules : Education or Wil's Role Modules : Community Care; when they are installed their professions can be paid wages.
Early development: not yet verified in a running game. Load it after Wil's Community Framework. If you take it out of a game, use the developer action "Prepare Treasury for removal" first; its accounts stay in the save and are picked up again if you add it back.
Created by Spaceman_Wil. Uses Harmony by Andreas Pardeike.
